title: Mizohata–Takeuchi slogan
summary: MT-type inequalities constrain how Fourier energy from a curved frequency support can concentrate: in slogan form, concentration should be no worse than along tubes (straight-line X-ray averages). Origin linked to 1970s dispersive PDE (Mizohata–Takeuchi).

title: Bridge on the analysis tower
summary: In popular tower narrative, MT was hoped as a free escalator toward Stein-type restriction/endpoint questions. Partial cases proved over ~40 years; community confidence grew.

title: Hannah Cairo counterexample (2025)
summary: Hannah Cairo (homeschooled, Bahamas → Berkeley classes as teen) attacks a homework weakening of MT, fails to prove it, then constructs a counterexample: geometrically structured frequency lattice/constellation whose diffraction concentrates energy beyond any straight-tube X-ray control (with quantitative log-loss sharpness in the telling). ArXiv ~Feb 2025, sole author age 17 in popular account.

title: What survives after the bridge collapses
summary: No previously proved theorem is deleted; the optimistic free path closes. Weakened/lossy variants and spherical cases may remain open. Tao blog commentary; same spring as Wang–Zahl Kakeya; Cairo later PhD offers / Davidson Fellows award in popular telling. LO6: verify dates and award details.
